findings.message: `CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM refresh_date) AS STRING) = '30'` wraps the partition column `refresh_date` in EXTRACT(DAY FROM ...), so BigQuery can't use it to skip partitions of `proj.web.trends`; the query reads every partition (3.2 GB in all).
findings.fix: Compare `refresh_date` itself with a constant, for example `refresh_date >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)`.
